sentences.text: Learned counsel for the informant submitted that the charge-sheet no.11 of 2023 has been filed on 23.5.2023 in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
A copy whereof has been annexed with the short counter affidavit.
4. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
5. Learned counsel for the informant undertakes to inform learned counsel for the petitioners about this order.
